changelog: Fixes the Orca Observatory dashboard, which rendered as a blank page in 1.0.12.0. The engine serializes its responses with property names exactly as declared, and the dashboard's snapshot reader expected the other capitalisation - so one lookup returned nothing, reading a field from it threw, and React tore the whole page down before anything drew. The dashboard now reads every field from the engine case-insensitively, with defaults for anything absent, so a payload it does not recognise can no longer blank it. Three further hardening changes came out of the same fault: each page is wrapped in an error boundary, so a failure in one panel shows that panel's error and leaves the rest of the dashboard working instead of emptying the screen; the dashboard now waits for the Jellyfin page container to appear rather than assuming it is present the instant its script runs; and the page carries visible placeholder text, so a script that never executes is distinguishable at a glance from one that started and failed. Upgrade directly from 1.0.12.0 - there are no configuration or database changes, and no engine behaviour changes.
